comment: Hand-picked ClawHub skills surfaced on the Discover tab's Featured rail. Editorial — what xagent recommends, not what ClawHub trends. Keep this list short (≤6) so the rail stays a real recommendation, not a second catalog. Add or remove items to update what users see; backend re-reads this file every request (cheap, no restart).

items.reason: Connect agents to your Notion workspace — pages, databases, search.
Read repos, file issues, browse PRs via the gh CLI from chat.
Google Workspace CLI — Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts in one skill.
Read and write your Obsidian vault from chat.
Meta-skill — ask the agent to scaffold a new skill for you.
Manage MCP servers (list, configure, auth, call) from the agent itself.
